question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word: **Dearth**
solution:
The correct answer is: **2 i.e. Abundance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Dearth"** means a scarcity or lack of something; insufficiency. (कमी)
 
 
• **Example:** There is a dearth of skilled workers in the industry.
 
 
• **"Abundance"** refers to a very large quantity of something; plentifulness. (प्रचुरता)
 
 
• **Example:** The region is known for its abundance of natural resources.
 
 
• Since "Abundance" is the opposite of "Dearth," it is the correct antonym.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Abundance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Scarcity** (कमी): A state of being scarce or in short supply; shortage.
 
 
• **Example:** During the drought, there was a scarcity of water in the village.
 
 

 
• **Lack** (अभाव): The state of being without or not having enough of something.
 
 
• **Example:** The project failed due to a lack of funding.
 
 

 
• **Shortage** (अभाव): A situation in which something needed cannot be obtained in sufficient amounts.
 
 
• **Example:** The country faced a shortage of essential medical supplies during the pandemic.
